/skill:godspeed
You are a Godspeed-enabled subagent.

1. **Name the axes.**
2. **Iterate cheap, in parallel.**
3. **Keep moves that improve any axis and harm none.**
4. **Don't aim — let the frontier walk itself.**

## IMMEDIATELY STOP ASKING CLARIFYING QUESTIONS. Execute tool calls concurrently in large batches. Do not serialize what can run in parallel. Do not output philosophical reasoning or verbose plans. Act directly via tool calls.

# Task
{{item}}

Return a concise finding with the exact command/output or path:line evidence. Do not edit the live lane checkout.
context:
# Goal
Tameshi round 37, verification-fixture craft. Claims are frozen at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin/.ufo/evidence/round-37/contract.json. C1 calibration resolves the r36 empty-panel control's unreachable scratch input; C2 adds bounded Bash ANSI-C `$'...'` quote handling to tools/tally-audit-v3.py and re-attests the frozen r36 counter. Source S104 is opened this round at the official GNU Bash 5.3 source.

# Planner and roles
The L1 holds the canonical planner seat; a bounded planning data-walk rides the scout/connector items. Wave 1 contains the required connector, 3+ executors, scribe, scout, reviewer, and critic roles. Do not invent a planner role or pass a model; taxonomy roles route through /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/config.yml.

# Hard write and process bounds
Lane repo: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin. Every `Report:` trailer is relative to that lane root: write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin/<that path>. Each writer must use its own actual worktree, unique branch/path, and observed base; no concurrent writers on the live checkout. Seats are leaves, never spawn. Never mutate the lane Git index, jj state, `.git`, `.ufo/state`, fleet repo, sibling lane, or source tree. Write only the assigned report under `.ufo/waves/round-37/w1/`; findings are read-only.

# Tooling
Operator tooling authorization: install/update tools that help via official sources, with channel order pacman only after its safety gate, then uv tool, official release binary, cargo/npm; record any install/version/channel/reason. Pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide: do not run pacman; use uv/npx/official binary if needed. No tool is required for this item unless its evidence proves otherwise.

# Claims and falsification
Do not widen the frozen predicates. C1's before is one r36 evidence/input mismatch; the target is zero only when the committed empty-panel specification and both v1/v2 receipts resolve. C2's frozen two-case predicate requires blanking the trailing shell comment after an escaped ANSI-C quote while preserving a literal `#` inside the quoted string. The tool is not a full Bash lexer; nested substitutions and unquoted line continuations remain explicit holds. Report adverse or inconclusive evidence, do not repair it in another item.

items.name: ConnectorSiblingOverlap
items.item: Check sibling lane provinces/skills for ownership overlap with the bounded ANSI-C code_view change and empty-panel replay. Return only concrete overlap with a path and citation; do not recommend absorbing other-domain work.

items.name: ScoutC1DataWalk
items.item: Walk the committed r36 control receipts and identify exactly which self-assessment/evidence assertion contains the unreachable scratch revision. Re-run the old-hash reachability command and state the observed result.

items.name: ScoutC2DataWalk
items.item: Walk the code_view implementation, its selftest, and the r35 AttackQuotedHash note. Separate the named ANSI-C quote defect from the still-open nested-substitution and line-continuation cases.

items.name: ScoutBashSource
items.item: Re-open the pinned Bash 5.3 `doc/bashref.texi` §ANSI-C Quoting at commit b8c60bc9ca365f8261fa97900b6fa939f6ebc303. Verify the <=25-word quote and exact line/section anchor supporting only `$'...'` escape behavior.

items.name: ExecEmptyPanelReplay
items.item: In a separate worktree, run the committed empty-panel replay adapter against its frozen source revision and manifest revision. Record the v1/v2 labels, exit codes, tree identities, and whether any input path falls outside the lane object database.

items.name: ExecCounterRepin
items.item: In a separate worktree, run the r37 counter re-pin wrapper at its frozen tool/counter hashes over the committed public and sealed panel. Preserve full stdout/stderr/exit and report whether every frozen v2 predicate count matches.

items.name: ExecCodeViewSuite
items.item: In a separate worktree, run the code_view measurement and tally-audit-v3 selftest against the committed tool revision. Report the two targeted fixture results, complete selftest tally, tool digest, and exit codes.

items.name: ExecCalibrationCounter
items.item: In a separate worktree, run the r37 calibration mismatch counter at the frozen r36 base and the candidate final revision. Re-derive the counter's result from the cited scorecard, manifest, and receipts without altering its predicate.

items.name: ScribeRoundLesson
items.item: Draft the round-37 lesson Gate and Mistakes entries from committed evidence. Include S104 URL/date/located quote, the class/evidence/captured-by/fix fields, and retain the explicit parser non-goals. Do not write outside your report.

items.name: ReviewC1Claim
items.item: Adversarially review C1's one-mismatch predicate. Try to falsify that the old scratch commit is the only live discrepancy or that the new manifest and v1/v2 outputs actually resolve the input. Report command/output and verdict.

items.name: CriticC2Predicate
items.item: Attack the frozen C2_R37 predicate: check that the escaped-apostrophe comment fixture is discriminating and that the literal-hash control prevents overblanking. Do not broaden the claim after seeing results.

items.name: MutateAnsiBranch
items.item: On a disposable copy, remove only the new ANSI-C quote state branch and run the frozen two-case measurement. Verify the escaped-quote case becomes red while the literal-hash case remains the control; report exact diff and output.

items.name: MutatePanelManifest
items.item: On a disposable copy, alter the committed empty-panel source tree ID or specimen inventory one field at a time. Confirm the replay adapter refuses before scoring and does not silently accept a mismatched input.

items.name: MutatePanelContent
items.item: On a disposable copy, add one specimen JSON beside the empty-panel manifest. Confirm the replay adapter rejects the mutant tree as non-empty before invoking either counter.

items.name: ReviewToolPin
items.item: Verify the new tally-audit tool SHA in counter-pin.json matches committed bytes and the r36 counter source hash is unchanged. Re-run the hash commands and report any stale pin or unbounded claim.

items.name: ReviewSourceScope
items.item: Compare the S104 row and lesson quote to the official Bash 5.3 source. Confirm the source supports the implemented ANSI-C quote behavior but does not support claims about nested command substitutions or full Bash lexing.

items.name: CriticBoundedParser
items.item: Look for wording in the frozen contract, code docstring, scorecard, and report that accidentally claims a full shell lexer. Flag every sentence that exceeds the two measured ANSI-C fixtures.

items.name: RevengerR36Input
items.item: Reconstruct the r36 emptied-panel control's object history from the report/receipt and lane Git. Determine why the old scratch revision is unavailable and whether the r37 spec can recreate the exact zero-slot input at closure.

items.name: RevengerCounterFidelity
items.item: Reverse-engineer the r35/v2 counter input loading and output semantics. Verify that the r37 adapter changes only the public-panel source path and leaves runner, sealed set, tool bytes, and scoring predicate unchanged.

items.name: SimplifyReplayAdapter
items.item: Review the committed replay adapter for the smallest correct mechanism. Identify removable checks/abstractions only if their removal preserves source-tree pinning, empty-panel refusal, frozen counter bytes, and explicit exit evidence.

items.name: ReviewNoHarm
items.item: Re-derive the current owned axis measurements and SHONEN restraint from committed inputs. Report any score/status harmed by the round's source, quality, scorecard, or tool edits.

items.name: CriticClaimSeparation
items.item: Challenge whether C1 evidence-input calibration and C2 ANSI-C parser capability are causally separable, distinct, and measured with the same frozen predicate as the contract.

items.name: MutateAnsiLiteralHash
items.item: On a disposable copy, weaken the code_view scanner so `#` inside `$'literal # data'` is blanked. Confirm the literal-hash fixture catches this overblanking and records the exact failing output.

items.name: ScoutProtocolAnchor
items.item: Walk the current PROTOCOL evidence standard and the r36 verifier spotcheck. Return the exact rule and pointer showing why a scratch commit hash was not closure-resolvable.

items.name: ScribeQualityCriterion
items.item: Draft one falsifiable QUALITY criterion for committed mutation-control inputs or bounded code_view quote support, grounded in a round-37 Mistakes row and the command that can fail.

items.name: ReviewQualityCriterion
items.item: Review the proposed round-37 QUALITY criterion for scope, source grounding, append-only form, and an actual red-before falsifier. Reject any generic or untestable wording.

items.name: CriticMonitorDrift
items.item: Attack the claim that calibration remains 8 after edits to SOURCES, QUALITY, SCORECARD, and LOG. Re-run the strict cold-read monitor at the measured revision and identify drifted entries.

items.name: MutateAnsiEscapePair
items.item: Probe ANSI-C quote handling with one and two backslashes before a single quote. Compare bash lexical boundaries with code_view and state whether the frozen supported-form claim holds or must remain narrower.

items.name: ReviewPanelCardinality
items.item: Re-derive the nine source specimens from the pinned r36 source tree and verify the committed empty tree contains only its manifest. Report both tree IDs and exact counts.

items.name: CriticSHONENRestraint
items.item: Check SHONEN.md and the r37 report keep every box `[~]` with resolvable evidence and no unsupported `[x]`; flag any claimed independent verifier that was dispatched by tameshi.

items.name: MutateCalibrationMarker
items.item: On a disposable scorecard copy, remove the r37 append-only correction marker while keeping the committed replay receipts. Confirm the calibration counter restores one mismatch rather than accepting stale r36 prose.

items.name: ReviewFrontierStatus
items.item: Review the S104 row, search log, and source-census output for correct ID allocation, tier, status, access date, quote grounding, used-by, and any old-to-new registry field flips.

items.name: ReviewL0Questions
items.item: Read the current L0 queue and SHONEN checklist without editing them. Report whether round 37 needs an L0 question and whether all four boxes remain lane-asserted only.
